real_use_case: Normalize E1A single-sample sequence-resolved SNV and indel VCF records against the exact verified reference before canonical variant modeling.
upstream_status: BCFtools 1.24 with HTSlib 1.24, release/tag identity pinned in the executor profile.
license: Project-owned adapter. External BCFtools/HTSlib bytes are not redistributed; the supported build profile uses the MIT/Expat license choice with GSL and Perl filters disabled.
supported_profile: Validated single-sample VCF 4.5; verified NCBI RefSeq GCF_000001405.40 / GRCh38.p14 reference; primary autosomes 1-22; sequence-resolved SNV and indel records.
resource_budget: Streams and hashes the reference before execution; BCFtools sort is capped at 256M memory and uses an isolated temporary workspace; no network access is required.
input_fixture: tests/fixtures/variant_normalization/input.vcf with synthetic-reference.fa; full GRCh38.p14 conformance remains private.
output_contract: VariantNormalizationResult with normalized VCF digest, VariantTransformationLedger, and explicit post-transform rule results.
known_issues: No numeric small-indel cutoff is invented here; upstream E1A profile governance owns that boundary. Multiallelic decomposition explicitly invalidates native multiallelic genotype/phase semantics while preserving the source genotype in the ledger. Contig alias rewriting is not performed.
security: Pinned executable digest and version, verified reference digest, argv-only subprocess execution with shell disabled, bounded sort memory, timeout, isolated temporary workspace, no network, and no private path emitted into normalized VCF.
disable_path: Do not invoke unless ReferenceIdentityResult is VERIFIED and the exact reference and executor digests match; this capability is not wired to a default execution pipeline.
